description: This file defines APIs and helper functions for managing parallel execution, including thread management, parallel loops, and reduction operations within the PyTorch framework. It sets up thread pools, provides parallel for/reduce mechanisms, and includes thread initialization and guard classes.

classes.name: at::internal::ThreadIdGuard
classes.description: A RAII guard class that temporarily sets the thread ID in a thread and restores it upon destruction.

methods.name: int64_t divup(int64_t x,int64_t y)
methods.description: Computes the ceiling of x divided by y, useful for dividing work into chunks.

methods.name: init_num_threads
methods.description: Initializes the number of threads used for parallel execution.

methods.name: set_num_threads
methods.description: Sets the number of threads to be used in parallel regions.

methods.name: get_num_threads
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of threads available for parallel regions.

methods.name: get_thread_num
methods.description: Returns the current thread's ID within a parallel region.

methods.name: in_parallel_region
methods.description: Checks whether the current code is executing within a parallel region.

methods.name: void lazy_init_num_threads()
methods.description: Lazily initializes thread count during the first parallel call.

methods.name: set_thread_num
methods.description: Sets the current thread's ID within a parallel region.

methods.name: ThreadIdGuard(int new_id)
methods.description: A helper class that changes thread ID temporarily within its scope.

methods.name: parallel_for
methods.description: Executes a user function in parallel over a range of indices, dividing work into chunks.

methods.name: parallel_reduce
methods.description: Performs a parallel reduction over a range of indices using user-provided combine functions.

methods.name: get_parallel_info
methods.description: Returns a string detailing current parallelization settings.

methods.name: set_num_interop_threads
methods.description: Sets the number of threads used for inter-op parallelism.

methods.name: get_num_interop_threads
methods.description: Returns the number of threads used for inter-op parallelism.

methods.name: launch_no_thread_state
methods.description: Launches a task without thread local state, used internally.

methods.name: intraop_launch
methods.description: Launches intra-op parallel task provided as a lambda.

methods.name: intraop_default_num_threads
methods.description: Returns the default number of intra-op threads.
